item.title: Why Overcast Days Are the Best Days to Fish
item.description: Most anglers pack up when clouds roll in. This is one of the most costly mistakes in fishing. Overcast skies do several things that make fish feed more aggressively — and once you understand the science, you'll never quit fishing the clouds.

item.title: Montana FWP Proposes New Cutthroat Protection Zones
item.description: The proposed regulations would close 14 miles of prime fishing water to protect native fish populations. Public comment period ends May 15 — make your voice heard at the FWP website.
